title: Grilled Jazzy Koji Skewers with Peruvian Glaze
description: A fusion of Peruvian and Japanese flavors, these skewers are perfect for a summer evening. The jazzy notes in the koji add a unique twist to the classic grilled dish.
instructions: 2. Thread jazzy koji, crunchy vegetables, and peruvian corn onto skewers.
3. Brush skewers with shio and season with causas crust.
5. Meanwhile, prepare Peruvian glaze by mixing 1 tablespoon of soy sauce, 1 tablespoon of honey, and 1 tablespoon of lime juice.
6. Brush glaze onto skewers during the last 2 minutes of grilling.
7. Serve hot with grilled peruvian corn on the side.
